capabilities: add job applications through a command palette form
track stages, deadlines, and history in a dashboard tab
create preparation notes with job descriptions
configure database file, notes folder, and interface language
disambiguation: Not a general workflow automation tool; the name refers to tracking the flow of job applications.
extras: Free and open source (MIT); no telemetry or external services; demo database with 12 fictional applications is available; README notes mobile testing remains pending; advanced setup, migration, and data model docs are linked separately.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage a job search pipeline, so users had to assemble tracking with QuickAdd and Dataview setups.
summary: Job application tracker that records applications, recruitment stages, deadlines, and preparation notes in a Markdown database with a filterable dashboard.
